theme_strategy.rationale: Enterprise ERP systems for manufacturing and warehouse operations prioritize data legibility and long-session usability. Light mode with neutral grey surfaces reduces eye strain when dealing with dense tables and forms.

headings.usage: Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight). Avoid Inter for headings to prevent generic 'AI slop' look.

body.usage: Use for all data tables, inputs, and dense UI elements.

app_shell.sidebar: Collapsible desktop-first sidebar. Width 256px expanded, 80px collapsed. Needs 14 roles so categorize links into groups (e.g., Core, Inventory, Sales).
app_shell.topbar: Sticky header with Global Search input, Notifications bell, Profile dropdown. Height 64px. Border bottom 1px solid slate-200.
app_shell.main_content: Padding p-6 or p-8. Contains breadcrumbs at the top, then page header (title + actions), then content (tables/dashboard).

dashboard_grid.pattern: High Density Grid (Bento Grid Mode B)
widgets: Middle row: Main Chart (col-span-3) + Quick Actions/Approvals (col-span-1).

data_tables.style: Clean, flat borders. Avoid heavy shadows. Use border-collapse.
data_tables.features: Filters above table, sortable headers, pagination below table.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-slate-200 on all surfaces. No heavy drop shadows; use shadow-sm for cards.
visual_enhancers.radius: rounded-md (moderate 6px) to maintain a structural, serious enterprise look.
visual_enhancers.buttons: Flat, sharp appearance. Primary button uses Forest Green. Secondary uses outline.
visual_enhancers.micro_interactions: Hover states on all buttons and table rows. Focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500/50) on inputs.

component_instructions.cards: Use Shadcn Card, but override shadow to be very minimal (shadow-sm) and add a 1px border. No oversized cards.
component_instructions.tables: Use standard HTML table inside a border-rounded container for simplicity and performance in data-heavy apps. Add sticky headers.
component_instructions.forms: Use Shadcn Form/Input. 2-column grid for long forms. Labels must be clearly visible above inputs.
component_instructions.breadcrumbs: Essential for navigation. text-sm text-slate-500. Use lucide 'ChevronRight' separator.
component_instructions.status_badges: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) with subtle backgrounds (e.g., bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 for Approved).

motion.transitions: Use targeted transitions, never 'all'. transition-colors duration-200 for hover states. Collapsible sidebar needs transition-width duration-300 ease-in-out.
motion.loading: Skeleton loaders for dashboard widgets and tables instead of spinners.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text meets WCAG AA standards. Forest Green on white is excellent. Avoid light grey text on light grey backgrounds.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have visible focus rings.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='sidebar-toggle').

product_protein.description: Protein powder bottle, use in Products CRUD list.

product_vitamin.description: Vitamin pills bottle, use in Products CRUD list.

warehouse_bg.description: Warehouse shelves, use for warehouse location empty states or header graphics.

user_profile.description: Professional headshot, use for user profile icon in top navbar.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install custom fonts by adding the google_fonts_url to index.html and configuring tailwind.config.js with fontFamily 'Chivo' and 'IBM Plex Sans'.
Use standard HTML+Tailwind for layouts, use Shadcn for complex interactives (Dropdown Menu, Dialogs, Selects).
Build a robust layout component with a collapsible sidebar. Do not use an oversized hamburger menu on desktop.
Dashboard KPIs should follow the 'Metric -> Target -> Variance -> Exception' mental model. Use Recharts for the main revenue/inventory chart.
For the Products CRUD, use the provided product_protein and product_vitamin images for dummy data.
Apply Forest Green (bg-emerald-700) exclusively for primary CTA buttons (e.g., 'Create Order', 'Approve') to guide action.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid generic centered layouts and excessive gradients.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💡).
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, focus rings.
Use generous spacing but keep tables dense enough for data entry (py-2 px-3 for cells).
Never use purely transparent backgrounds on overlays/headers.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute for automated testing.
